key_changes: Added import for apply_list_filters and FilterConfig from apps.core.list_utils
Replaced manual filter extraction from request.GET with declarative FilterConfig objects
Implemented custom stock_status_filter function for complex conditional filtering
Consolidated filter application, ordering, and pagination into single apply_list_filters call
Updated context dictionary to use result dictionary returned from apply_list_filters

patterns_discovered.description: Moved from imperative filter chaining to declarative FilterConfig objects that specify filter type, parameter name, and behavior
patterns_discovered.benefit: Improves code readability and maintainability by centralizing filter definitions
patterns_discovered.applicability: Suitable for views with multiple filter parameters

patterns_discovered.description: Isolated complex conditional logic (stock status filtering) into a dedicated filter function passed to FilterConfig
patterns_discovered.benefit: Separates business logic from filter orchestration, making logic testable and reusable
patterns_discovered.applicability: Useful for non-standard filters that don't map directly to ORM field filters

patterns_discovered.description: Single apply_list_filters call handles filter application, ordering, and pagination instead of inline logic
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces code duplication across views and ensures consistent behavior
patterns_discovered.applicability: Applicable to all list views in the application

patterns_discovered.description: apply_list_filters returns a dictionary with 'queryset' and 'filter_values', which are unpacked into context
patterns_discovered.benefit: Provides clean separation between filtered results and original filter parameters
patterns_discovered.applicability: Standard return pattern for list filtering utilities

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Context variable mapping from result dictionary
gotchas_discovered.description: Original context variables (search, selected_warehouse, etc.) are now sourced from result['filter_values'] instead of direct request.GET values
gotchas_discovered.impact: Templates must continue to use the same context key names; no changes needed if context dictionary keys remain consistent
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Context keys are preserved in the refactored code (search, selected_warehouse, selected_material_type, selected_stock_status)

gotchas_discovered.description: Default ordering is specified as 'material__code' in apply_list_filters call; original code had dual sort by 'material__code' and 'warehouse__code'
gotchas_discovered.impact: Secondary sort by warehouse code is lost; results may not maintain same sort order as before
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify with apply_list_filters API whether it supports multiple default orderings or if this limitation is acceptable

gotchas_discovered.description: Original code passed paginator result to context; refactored code only passes queryset from result
gotchas_discovered.impact: Templates expecting pagination metadata (total pages, page numbers) may break
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify that apply_list_filters includes pagination metadata in result dictionary

gotchas_discovered.description: Custom filter function checks for exact string values ('low', 'out', 'normal') - case sensitive
gotchas_discovered.impact: If request parameters have different casing or unexpected values, filter defaults to no filtering
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider adding .lower() normalization or validating against allowed values

approach_outcome.description: Successfully refactored stock_list view to use apply_list_filters utility function
key_achievements: Eliminated 36 lines of imperative filter code
Implemented declarative filter configuration with FilterConfig objects
Integrated custom filter logic for complex stock status filtering
Centralized filter, ordering, and pagination logic into single utility call
testing_implications: Unit tests should verify each FilterConfig behavior (search, field filters, custom filter)
Integration tests should confirm pagination still works correctly with apply_list_filters
Template tests should verify context variables are correctly populated from result dictionary
approach_outcome.code_quality_impact: positive - reduced code duplication, improved maintainability through declarative configuration

recommendations.recommendation: Verify pagination metadata is included in apply_list_filters result
recommendations.rationale: Templates may depend on pagination context variables not visible in the diff
recommendations.action: Check apply_list_filters return value structure and compare with template requirements

recommendations.recommendation: Verify secondary ordering by warehouse code is acceptable to remove
recommendations.rationale: Original code had order_by('material__code', 'warehouse__code') but refactored only has 'material__code'
recommendations.action: Review product requirements or test results to confirm sort order change is acceptable

recommendations.recommendation: Consider extracting stock_status_filter to a separate utility module
recommendations.rationale: Complex filter logic is better tested and reused if extracted from view function
recommendations.action: Move stock_status_filter function to a dedicated filters module or to core.list_utils

recommendations.recommendation: Add validation for stock_status filter values
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation silently ignores invalid values instead of raising errors
recommendations.action: Add value validation or document expected values (low, out, normal)

recommendations.recommendation: Document FilterConfig object structure and available filter types
recommendations.rationale: Future developers need to understand how to add new filters
recommendations.action: Add inline docstring or reference documentation for FilterConfig usage

recommendations.recommendation: Plan refactoring of other list views to use apply_list_filters utility
recommendations.rationale: This pattern can be applied to other views like warehouse_list, material_list, etc.
recommendations.action: Identify other list views in the codebase and create refactoring plan
